d: The role holder is responsible for providing pro-active, efficient and effective maintenance and operations management services to all NBB Group properties covering (NBB, BisB and Overseas branches) to meet high service standards and protect the bank’s assets. The role holder will also manage various group property projects including overseas branches and donations.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline is required.
Master's degree in a related discipline is preferred.
Minimum 5-6 years of practical experience in a bank with 3 years in the same or similar function.
r: Oversee the day-to-day management of the Bank’s properties, ensuring compliance with CBB regulations, operational standards, and safety requirements.
Coordinate office space utilization, project purchases, and facility management to optimize costs and operational efficiency.
Ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations, supporting the Bank’s governance framework.
Develop and implement long-term property and facilities management plans, ensuring alignment with the Bank’s business growth and efficiency goals.
Oversee property lifecycle management, from acquisition to disposal, ensuring assets align with operational and financial objectives.
Improve the occupancy rate for Group owned properties.
Manage the property management budget, ensuring cost control, efficiency, and strategic allocation of resources and support Group Head of Property in preparing CAPEX & OPEX).
Develop financial reports and forecasts to support decision-making on property investments, lease agreements, and maintenance costs.
Track and review the report on utility usage, implementing energy-efficient operations to reduce costs.
Prepare regular reports on property performance, maintenance activities, and financial metrics.
Identify and implement cost-saving initiatives related to leases, vendor contracts, and operational expenses
Deliver the group property project portfolio, ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and according to scope.
Conduct site inspections, manage project handovers, and prepare snag lists to ensure compliance with specifications.
Oversee subcontractor and fit-out management (where applicable), ensuring seamless transitions for maintenance and renewals.
Support the tendering, awarding, and supervision of service contracts, ensuring compliance with procurement policies.
Assess and recommend real estate opportunities, including branch expansions, consolidations, and lease negotiations.
Monitor the performance of maintenance contractors, ensuring adherence to KPIs, SLAs, and service quality standards.
Maintain an up-to-date asset register and maintenance records to track property conditions.
Oversee preventive maintenance schedules and life cycle replacements for MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) equipment.
Ensure compliance with Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) policies, conducting regular inspections.
Supervise renovation and maintenance works, ensuring contractors follow safety regulations and work standards.
Perform regular site visits of Group Properties ensuring highest standards and operation function of all property related equipment.

Drives revenue to achieve Hotel’s topline goals for each of their represented hotels by proactively soliciting all business segments; to include new business from small business accounts, sourcing new accounts, identifying new targets, and re-soliciting past business leads. Focuses on properties BT Pricing strategy. Provides property support by coordinating and executing property internal mining efforts at assigned hotels. Partners with Leadership to ensure competitive sales strategies are in place for the hotel and stay competitive within the market by aligning on sales activities to generate business and communicate real-time competitor intel. Reports directly to Property Sales Leader (ASL or DOS/DOSM) and works closely with the hotel General Managers, focuses on sales driven tasks. May work with Local Sales and U.S. Account Sales/GSO teams to drive production from targeted high priority accounts including maximizing special corporate business within the represented market place.
q: High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing, guest services, front desk, or related professional area.
2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required.

4-year college degree; previous experience in proactive lead generation in hospitality and sales discipline; knowledge of property-specific business segments (e.g. group, catering, transient); knowledge the hospitality industry.
